title: Sethite theory adopted by Jews and by the church through Augustine

tellings.quote: verse. And and what they did was uh they said that the the sons of God in Genesis 6 that that populated with the daughters of Adam that these were noble men from the line of Seth

plain: An old reading of Genesis 6, the Bible passage where the "sons of God" have children with human women, says those sons of God were simply noble men from the family line of Seth, a son of Adam. Tim Alberino, a guest who researches the giants of ancient lore, says this reading was taken up by Jewish teachers and then by the Christian church through Augustine, the early church thinker. He tells it in his own summary to show how the passage came to be read as being about ordinary humans.
